archetypes.name: dedup-robustness
archetypes.rationale: Exactly-once sidecar dedup logic uses an optional `seen` set that is scoped differently across three call sites: ci_monitor creates it per factory call, rebase never passes it, and agents.py makes it optional — plan requires dedup within each waterfall invocation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the exactly-once sidecar dedup logic introduced in `python/agents.py:ingest_launcher_token_sidecar`. Verify that every call site (`python/ci_monitor.py`, `python/rebase.py`) correctly scopes and passes the `seen` set so that dedup works within each waterfall invocation, not just within a single function call. Check whether `python/rebase.py:make_conflict_launch_fn` omitting `seen` can cause double-ingestion across multiple conflict-tier launches in one session. Examine `python/checks.py:_load_codex_model_args` which bypasses the `Runner` abstraction via raw `subprocess.run` — assess whether the fallback to `()` on failure is safe and whether this creates a gap in test coverage. Verify `record_vendor_from_sidecar` in `python/tokens.py` silently drops 'unknown' vendor rows without any diagnostic, and check whether that matches the plan's warn-not-fail requirement. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: pricing-authority
archetypes.rationale: Pricing authority is consolidated from report_tokens_models.py into report_tokens_cost.py; the migration completeness, rate table key naming consistency between Codex's `cache_read` vs `cached_input` naming, and correct exclusion of Claude from fleet-mix-derived blended defaults all need verification.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that `env_rate` and `display_rates` are fully removed from `python/report_tokens_models.py` and that no other module still imports them from that path. In `python/report_tokens_cost.py`, check that `_blended_default` uses the correct key names when indexing into `DEFAULT_RATE_TABLE_PER_M` rows for Codex (table key `cache_read` vs `DisplayRates` field `codex_cached_input`) and confirm the fleet-mix sum for each vendor is arithmetically correct. Verify that `DEFAULT_CLAUDE_BLENDED_PER_M = 0.80` is a hardcoded constant and is NOT passed through `_blended_default`, as the plan requires. Check that `parse_token_record_sidecar` returning `None` on zero-token sidecars preserves all the no-op behaviors (absent file, empty file, malformed KV, zero totals) that the previous inline code in `append_token_record_from_sidecar` handled, and confirm the `execution-issues.md` diagnostic path was not lost in the refactor. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
